Detailed Description

Resource owner for bots, controllers, sensors, and actuators.

Owns the memory for bots, controllers, sensors, and actuators created through it.

◆ CreateActuator()

ActuatorHandle superdex::robotics::RoboticsContext::CreateActuator ( std::string_view typeName,
Actor * linkActor,
std::string_view name,
std::string_view paramArgs,
superdex::Error & error )

Create an actuator of the given type on the given link actor.

Unlike a sensor, an actuator always drives a body, so linkActor is required: passing None sets an error and returns an invalid handle. paramArgs is an optional params file path or inline JSON string; empty uses default-constructed parameters. name is the instance name used by FindActuatorsByName and need not be unique. The owning bot is inferred from linkActor. Returns a handle. For bot-owned actuators, prefer declaring them in the BotPrefab so they are auto-instantiated and destroyed with the bot.

Parameters
[in]typeNameRegistered actuator type name.
[in]linkActorActor the actuator drives; must not be None.
[in]nameInstance name used by the name-based finders; need not be unique.
[in]paramArgsParams file path or inline JSON; empty uses defaults.
[in,out]errorError status. Check Error::IsOK for success.
Returns
Handle to the created actuator, or an invalid handle on error.

◆ CreateController()

ControllerHandle superdex::robotics::RoboticsContext::CreateController ( std::string_view typeName,
BotPrefab const * prefab,
Actor * robot,
std::string_view name,
superdex::Error & error )

Create a controller of the given type for robot.

Harvests model-derived configuration (e.g. per-joint effort limits) from the optional borrowed prefab: pass None to create on a raw articulated actor with no model (the prefab must outlive the controller otherwise).

robot may also be None, to drive a real robot with observations pushed in from outside instead of read off a Mochi articulation. Anything that needs the articulation (e.g. reading a Jacobian) then has to be supplied externally, and the controller reports an error if asked for it. A controller that cannot work at all without a simulation rejects the None actor itself — see ControllerMochiArticulatedPose, which drives Mochi's built-in implicit PD controller.

The owning bot is inferred from robot (see GetBotContainingActor): if that actor is a bot's articulation or one of its link actors, the controller is recorded against that bot, found by the bot-scoped finders, and destroyed with it; otherwise it has no owning bot. Bot::CreateController is the more direct way to create one on a bot you already hold, and also carries an instance name.

Parameters
[in]typeNameRegistered controller type name.
[in]prefabOptional borrowed robot-model description; may be None and must outlive the created controller.
[in]robotArticulated actor to control, or None for externally supplied observations.
[in]nameInstance name used by the name-based finders; need not be unique.
[in,out]errorError status. Check Error::IsOK for success.
Returns
Handle to the created controller, or an invalid handle on error.

SensorHandle superdex::robotics::RoboticsContext::CreateSensor ( std::string_view typeName,
Actor * linkActor,
std::string_view name,

Create a sensor of the given type on the given link actor.

paramArgs is an optional params file path or inline JSON string consumed by the factory; pass an empty view to use default-constructed parameters. name is the instance name used by FindSensorsByName and need not be unique. The owning bot is inferred from linkActor. Returns a handle. For bot-owned sensors, prefer declaring them in the BotPrefab so they are auto-instantiated and destroyed with the bot.

Parameters
[in]typeNameRegistered sensor type name.
[in]linkActorActor to attach the sensor to, or None for an actor-less sensor.
[in]nameInstance name used by the name-based finders; need not be unique.
[in]paramArgsParams file path or inline JSON; empty uses defaults.
[in,out]errorError status. Check Error::IsOK for success.
Returns
Handle to the created sensor, or an invalid handle on error.

◆ FindBotsByName()

DynamicArray< BotHandle > superdex::robotics::RoboticsContext::FindBotsByName ( std::string_view name) const
nodiscard

Find all bots whose name (from BotPrefab::name) equals name.

Bot names are not unique (multiple bots may share a prefab name), so any number of handles may be returned (empty if none). There is no FindBotsByType: a bot has no registered type.

Parameters
[in]nameExact bot name to match.
Returns
Handles of every matching live bot; empty if none.

◆ GetBotContainingActor()

Bot * superdex::robotics::RoboticsContext::GetBotContainingActor ( Actor const * actor) const
nodiscard

Find the bot containing actor.

Accepts either a bot's articulation actor or any of its link actors. Returns null when the actor is contained by no bot, which is a valid result: a scene may hold standalone actors and articulations from plain mochi prefabs alongside its bots. A null actor also returns null.

Parameters
[in]actorActor to locate; may be None.
Returns
Context-owned bot containing the actor, or None if none.
